claims_to_fix.statement: CHI3L1 was significantly upregulated in UC patients and strongly correlated with NLRP3 inflammasome expression. One study reports that CHI3L1 promotes macrophage pyroptosis via the BCAT1/NF-kappaB axis. Velpatasvir binding to recombinant CHI3L1 was confirmed in vitro by microscale thermophoresis. This is early preclinical work with no approved CHI3L1 drug.

claims.reason: No cited record states drug approval status.

claims_to_fix.statement: HMGCS2 expression decreased in UC (with AQP8) in two separate studies, and one states these genes have high diagnostic value for UC. Together with SLC26A3, which is lower in UC patients versus controls in ONT-RNA-seq, this supports an epithelial metabolic/transport loss signature. No therapeutic targeting is reported.
